summary: Cognyte Software Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its annual general meeting of shareholders held September 3, 2026. Shareholders voted on two routine proposals: re-election of three Class II directors (Dafna Sharir, Avi Cohen, Matthew O'Neill) and appointment of Kesselman Kesselman (PwC member firm) as independent auditors. Each director received over 43 million votes in favor; auditor appointment passed with 46.6 million votes. Quorum of 46,705,281 shares (63.24% of outstanding) was present. This is a routine meeting results disclosure with no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, tender offers, or strategic changes.
